reason: I only pay when the thing is in my hand. You want the item price and your fee before anything ships, from a page I have never heard of, and I have friends who sent money like that and never saw it again.
objection: Paying up front to a new page and then waiting 2 to 3 weeks with nothing. If the item is fake or wrong, will they really refund me, or just stop answering?
would_change_my_mind: Full cash on delivery, or at least a real office in Baghdad where I can pay in person and someone I know who already got their order from them.
